slug: 2025-10-17 Paradigm Initiative partners with Koneta Hub on data protection law in South Sudan

facts.fact: Paradigm Initiative and Koneta Hub held a two-day Juba convening of lawmakers, CSOs and officials to review the draft Data Protection Bill and seek parliamentary commitment to table it; the release is dated 2025-10-17 and gives no separate event date.
Koneta's Executive Director said the country lacks a comprehensive legal and institutional framework for the protection of personal data, with existing ICT regulations limited.
